item.title: From WordPress to Hugo: Lessons from a Static Site Migration
item.description: A hands-on account of migrating a technical blog from WordPress to Hugo, including theme selection, content migration challenges, and CI/CD automation lessons learned.

item.title: AI-Powered Security Automation: Automating Incident Response Workflows
